function calcCardHeight(colWidth, aspectRatio, padding?): number

Defined in: core/utils/wasm/wasm-layout.ts:81

Card height for a grid item: column width divided by aspect ratio, plus padding. A missing/zero ratio falls back to 16:9 so unsized CMS rows can't produce NaN or zero-height cards.

Parameters

colWidth

number

The column's width in px.

aspectRatio

number

width/height of the media.

padding?

number = 0

Extra vertical padding in px.

Returns

number

Card height in px.
